label: William L. Rowe, The Problem of Evil and…: Some actual occurring intense suffering is preventable…
locator: p. 336 §I n.3, read with premises (1) and (2)
interpretation: Conditional adoption of the footnote refinement, not a proved fact. The blocking-good range in the factual premise is widened together with the permission constraint, so actual gratuitous suffering becomes a stronger factual claim. No equivalent reading of the simplified p.336 premise (1) is asserted.
